courses.summary: 哈布尚天然氣處理樞紐是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為海陸多來源富氣與多種產品的物料平衡；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Habshan is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on material balances across onshore-offshore rich-gas feeds and multiple products, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
